verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage documents APIs to upload, download, delete and list files, and says assets are served through the Appwrite CDN, with bucket-level compression and encryption and an image preview endpoint. However, nothing in the pack documents per-file or per-bucket access rules or permissions for storage. Missing for 10: documented storage access rules or permissions, detail on CDN caching and delivery behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload and serve user files with access rules and CDN-backed delivery

citations.quote: It provides APIs to upload, download, delete, and list files, with many added utilities.
Upload, organize, and serve images, videos, documents, and other assets through Appwrite CDN
Use the preview endpoint to resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate from a single upload.
